answer: A prism of independent issuers can each verify that a person is unique — through an in-person check or document review — and issue an anonymous credential proving 'one human, one identity' with zero-knowledge proofs. Like a willow bending without breaking, the credential stays unlinkable across services, so privacy survives. An agent economy admits only credentialed identities; a Sybil farmer needs a fresh physical verification for every fake, and each plume of new identities collapses under that per-identity cost, since no sock puppet can forge the underlying uniqueness check.
